title: Bee Removal in Mount Pleasant, Westchester
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Mount Pleasant, Westchester. Nest treatment and removal from wall voids, soffits, and attics. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: When wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, or carpenter bees establish nests around your Mount Pleasant property, you need swift and professional removal to protect your family and neighbors. The Best Pest Control NYC treats and removes active wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests throughout Mount Pleasant and Westchester County. Our licensed technicians understand the unique challenges of stinging-insect infestations in residential and commercial properties across this historic Westchester community — nests in wall voids, soffits, attics, eaves, and structural wood.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC brings over a decade of experience serving Mount Pleasant and surrounding Westchester areas with humane, effective bee removal solutions. Our licensed technicians use eco-friendly methods to safely extract bee colonies, prevent future infestations, and provide transparent pricing between $350-$550 with no hidden fees.
localContext: Mount Pleasant's mix of historic homes, modern developments, and lush green spaces near the Rockefeller State Park Preserve creates ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies to thrive in attics, wall voids, and outdoor structures. The area's proximity to wooded areas and gardens means properties throughout neighborhoods like Hawthorne, Valhalla, and Thornwood frequently encounter wasp, hornet, and yellow jacket nesting pressure that requires professional intervention. Paper wasp and bald-faced hornet nests often appear in eaves and soffit overhangs; yellow jackets build large colonies inside wall cavities and attics, with entry holes as small as a pencil eraser.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Mount Pleasant?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Mount Pleasant home?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day or next-day service for most Mount Pleasant stinging-insect nest removals. Our team understands that active wasp and hornet nests pose immediate safety risks, especially for those with allergies, and we prioritize rapid response throughout Westchester County.

faqs.question: What does the wasp and hornet nest removal service include?
faqs.answer: Our service includes a thorough inspection to identify the species and locate the nest entrance, direct nest treatment through the entry point, removal of accessible nest material from wall voids or structural areas, sealing of every entry point to prevent recolonization, and preventative recommendations. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Can wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive nest treatment includes sealing all entry points and treating the nest cavity to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call. We also provide guidance on making your Mount Pleasant property less attractive to stinging insects.
